featured.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first three-way summit
featured.summary: At Kylin Villa in Shenzhen, the three leaders sign a four-point 'Declaration toward Peace' after a ~90-minute round table, reaffirming 'a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought'. No deal on Ukraine, Iran, trade or AI.

featured.headline: World court: Myanmar committed genocide
featured.summary: The ICJ rules 9-6 that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya in its 2017 clearance operations, the first time the court has held a state responsible for genocide. It orders reparations and a report within two years.

featured.headline: COP31 draft drops fossil fuels
featured.summary: A slimmed-down draft deal published Thursday strips out all fossil-fuel references and drops the $120bn adaptation-finance target from Monday's first draft. Ministers race to unblock the text in Antalya; talks run to Friday.

featured.headline: Anthropic debuts in record $81.3bn IPO
featured.summary: Shares priced at $83 open at $111.50 on Nasdaq under ticker ANT, the largest IPO ever, topping SpaceX's $75bn.

featured.headline: GTA VI launches after 13 years
featured.summary: Rockstar's game unlocks at midnight local time on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S at $79.99, and scores 99 on Metacritic from 140+ reviews.

featured.headline: Third strike in a week hits Crimea Bridge
featured.summary: Ukraine hits the Kerch Bridge a third time in four days, halting rail traffic; some services resume in the afternoon.

featured.headline: Denmark backs Greenland deal 109-0
featured.summary: The Folketing unanimously approves the US-Denmark-Greenland security pact, opening the way to more US bases after months of takeover tensions.

featured.headline: Cyclone Akvan nears India; 80,000+ moved
featured.summary: Odisha evacuates more than 80,000 people and deploys 74 rescue teams as severe cyclone Akvan nears; landfall forecast near Gopalpur by Friday noon, winds to 110 km/h.

featured.headline: 551,864 sit Korea's Suneung exam
featured.summary: South Korea goes quiet for its college entrance exam: offices open late, flights pause 25 minutes; 196,473 repeat takers.

featured.headline: Australia jobless rate hits 4.9%, a 5-year high
featured.summary: Employment falls 43,500 in October and youth joblessness reaches 11.3% as the Reserve Bank's rate rises bite.

featured.headline: Yunus home torched as Bangladesh burns
featured.summary: Arsonists torch ex-interim leader Muhammad Yunus's ancestral home in Chattogram; bombs and arson hit 28 of 64 districts.

featured.headline: Iran says three tankers hit mines
featured.summary: Iran's army says three oil tankers struck naval mines and caught fire east of Hormuz; the claim is unverified and disputed.

featured.headline: Israel ends tank raid beyond Yellow Line
featured.summary: Israel says it has concluded its tank raid near Nuseirat, the first ground push past the ceasefire line since the 2025 truce.

featured.headline: Houthi strike hits Riyadh's tallest tower
featured.summary: A Houthi attack damages several floors of the 80-storey PIF Tower in the financial district; no injuries are reported.

featured.headline: Indonesia passes asset-seizure law after 18 years
featured.summary: Parliament approves a law letting the state seize corruption-linked assets without a conviction in some cases.

sources_note: Every story verified against a primary reputable source (Reuters, AP, BBC, WSJ, IAEA, ICJ, IMD, ABS). CLAIM = unverified claim, never stated as fact. FORECAST = a forecast, not an outcome.
